summary: Every Google booking deeplink (single-pair tfs URL and the multi-city URL) must quote the same normalized --currency the search returned instead of hard-coding curr=USD.
reason: A user searching in EUR was handed a booking page quoting USD — the one surface where the price must match what the CLI just displayed. The HTML-fallback deeplink already propagated currency; booking_urls.go and multicity.go had drifted from it.
validated_outcome: unit tests cover EUR propagation, lowercase normalization, invalid-code fallback to USD, and the multi-city curr= parameter; live TSF>BER EUR search confirmed curr=EUR in booking_urls.primary.
